overview.description: The WBI BullBear Value 3000 ETF (WBIF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively-managed fund that focuses on global value stocks that pay dividends. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation with reduced volatility during market declines. WBIF was launched on Aug 27, 2014 and is issued by WBI Shares.

holdings.infoBox: WBIF is an equity ETF with a total of 51 individual holdings. The top holdings are Cash & Other stock at 36.45%, HP Inc. at 2.69%, Pegasystems at 2.67%, Trane Technologies at 2.54%, and Ross Stores at 2.53%.
